title: Law to create a Department of Community Safety
summary: This bill would establish a new city Department of Community Safety, led by a mayoral-appointed commissioner, to coordinate emergency responses and social services aimed at preventing violence and supporting vulnerable New Yorkers. The department would run offices in each borough operating around the clock, oversee contracts for alternatives to incarceration and violence prevention programs, and conduct field operations like outreach, safety patrols and conflict mediation. It would take effect 180 days after becoming law.
